automatic_zoom_initial_ranges.source: dist-electron/index.js Qye called from XX during project creation
automatic_zoom_initial_ranges.note: These are generated editing ranges, not the measured visual zoom-in and zoom-out times or the effective zoom level after settings and edits.

motion_blur_renderer.cursor_strength_source: global amount multiplied by cursor amount; zoom channel zero
motion_blur_renderer.screen_move_strength_source: global amount multiplied by screen move amount
motion_blur_renderer.screen_zoom_strength_source: global amount multiplied by screen zoom amount
motion_blur_renderer.selection: frame-bound changes select a move or zoom filter by the dominant change; zero or tiny changes may receive no filter
motion_blur_renderer.note: Static renderer path; effective sample count, final appearance, preview/export parity and runtime defaults need frame tests.
motion_blur_renderer.move_sample_distribution: center plus 20 extra equal-weight samples for kernel 21; bias vector * i/20, i = 0..19; one sample repeats center
motion_blur_renderer.parent_motion: recursive subtraction plus per-axis sign suppression in Q2
motion_blur_renderer.alpha_conversion_in_zoom_shader: extra premultiply/unpremultiply statements commented; input alpha representation unverified

desktop_spring_solver.integrator: semi-implicit Euler, milliseconds converted to seconds
desktop_spring_solver.fractional_tail_rule: ceil(dtMs) - dtMs when final index > dtMs
desktop_spring_solver.effective_precision_on_target_change: max(1, abs(current - target)) * config.precision; equal values return 1
desktop_spring_solver.note: Settle-time shortcut and zero-mass snap are additional paths. Static linkage to renderer established; website/desktop runtime equivalence unverified.

animation_timeline.time_quantization: near integer within strict 1e-7 tolerance then floor frame index
per_frame_order: map playback time to source time
set target for mapped source time
animation_timeline.fractional_frame_rendering: recursive linear interpolation between adjacent integer-frame styles
animation_timeline.reset_source_mapping: resetSpringAtTime requests styles with unmapped reset time; runtime effect for trims/speed changes unverified
